summary: The candidate implements the original issue's permitted rejection policy: any DeepSeek-V4 system message after a non-system turn is rejected, including when split across context and new messages. It also rejects system-only conversations, closing the prior independent-review counterexample. Validation occurs before tokenization and the serving wrapper maps ValueError to HTTP 400.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced acceptance without an assistant boundary for the original trailing-system prompt, system-only, developer-then-system, and context-user/new-system cases.
Confirmed rejection of every trailing/inline/system-only counterexample and preservation of valid leading-system-plus-user, context-system/new-user, and user-only boundaries.
11 DSV4-focused candidate tests passed, including original regression, system-order boundaries, and rejection before tokenizer.encode.
All 138 serving-chat unit tests passed at the exact candidate commit.

gpu_execution.evidence: The prepared environment detects one AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2, but no DeepSeek-V4 model inference was run; the qualified behavior is deterministic rejection before tokenization/model execution.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were unavailable, so the reported long-context first-token-EOS model symptom was not replayed.
No GPU model execution was performed; GPU detection alone is not claimed as model validation.
No native files changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot qualify DeepSeek-V4 prompt semantics or architecture-specific generation.
